entries.en: No sign of Commander Shepard. It doesn't look good.
Shepard! Shepard!
You gave us a hell of scare, Shepard. But you'll make a better hero than a martyr.
Thought I'd need a prison pass to see you again, Captain.
Good to see you, too.
They dropped the charges after Sovereign attacked the Citadel. Guess they figured helping you escape wasn't such a crime after all.
I thought you were going to be court-martialed.
You're not under arrest?
You've been through a hell of a lot, Commander. But there's one more thing you need to take care of.
My thoughts exactly.
Captain Anderson! We've found them! They're in here.
Take it easy... it's over. You're safe now.
Where's the commander? Where's Shepard?
Captain, we need to clear out. This entire area's unstable. Ships are waiting to evacuate us.
Commander Shepard is still missing. We don't leave anyone behind!
We've got partial decompression and loss of power all over the deck. And we need to get these survivors back to the med lab.
Contact the evac ships. Have them pick us up at the airlock.
Rescue 17, this is ground team. Meet us at the airlock for immediate evacuation.
The elevator's locked! Saren must have taken control of the Citadel systems and shut it down
The elevator's locked! Saren must have shut it down.
Saren's locked the elevator! Suit up - we're going outside!
Hold on!
Anderson? What are you doing here?
I didn't send for--
hunh
Commander? I don't know what the captain did, but all our systems just came back online.
Let's go. Get us out of here, Joker. Now!
Everything cuts out after that. No comm traffic at all. Just goes dead. There's nothing.
Take us in, Joker. Fast and quiet.
Tell Alenko and Jenkins to suit up, Commander. You're going in.
This mission just got a lot more complicated.
A small strike team can move quickly without drawing attention. It's our best chance to secure the beacon.
Bring it up on screen.
Reverse and hold at 38.5.
Seventeen minutes out, Captain. No other Alliance ships in the area.
Transmission from Eden Prime, sir. You better see this!
Grab your gear and meet us in the cargo hold.
The Council thought you could use some help on this one.
I wasn't expecting to find the geth here. The situation's bad.
I've got it under control.
This isn't your mission, Saren. What are you doing here?
Nihlus.
Look! The beacon.
It wasn't doing anything like that when they dug it up.
Something must have activated it.
This is amazing. Actual working Prothean technology. Unbelievable!
I wonder what-- ungh!
Shepard!
No! Don't touch her! It's too dangerous!
No! Don't touch him! It's too dangerous!
Ah!
Normandy, the beacon is secure. Request immediate evac.
Roger, Normandy. Standing by.
Normandy?
Set the charges. Destroy the entire colony. Leave no evidence that we were here.
Sir? This is a restricted area.
Sir? You can't be up here.
Stop or I'll shoot!
There it is! Get us out of here, Joker. Now!
Freeze! Back away from the console!
